title: Wire production loop quality-standard evaluation through the loop runner

output.summary: Approve production quality-standard execution through the CodeWiki loop runner.

approvedRows.question: DTR-runner-production-wiring
approvedRows.currentState: Production wiki facades still used synchronous quality-standard evaluation even though src/loops/runner.ts existed and was tested as a parallel runner substrate.
approvedRows.desiredState: wiki_decide, wiki_plan, and wiki_implement run production quality-standard evaluation through CodeWiki-owned runner adapters while preserving existing verdict and diagnostic semantics.
approvedRows.rationale: This completes the first production wiring slice for the Pi-lens-inspired runner architecture without introducing model-judge dependencies yet.
approvedRows.userImpact: Agents receive production loop output produced through the runner path with compact runner metadata.
approvedRows.maintainerImpact: Maintainers can evolve node scheduling and independent workers behind a tested production runner adapter.
approvedRows.routeRationale: Small, bounded architecture wiring with direct tests and no behavior change to verdict semantics.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Production wiki facades evaluate quality standards through runner-backed iteration paths.
Runner-backed exits preserve existing verdict, quality-standard, diagnostic, and route semantics.
Loop output includes compact qualityRunner graph/node latency metadata.

approvedRows.recommendationRationale: The change is additive runner wiring with equivalence tests and no public API break.

agentAssessment.userAlignment: The user approved wiring production loops through the runner next.
agentAssessment.projectBenefit: Moves runner architecture from substrate to production loop path.
agentAssessment.rationale: Deterministic equivalence tests reduce regression risk while enabling future non-deterministic worker nodes.

approvedRows.currentPain: The runner was available but not exercised on normal production loop attempts.
approvedRows.desiredOutcome: Production loop outputs include runner latency/node summaries and existing quality standards remain semantically identical.
approvedRows.successSignal: Tests prove runner-backed exits match synchronous exits for all three loops and API tests continue to pass.
nonGoals: Do not add model-judge workers yet.
Do not make non-deterministic checks authoritative yet.
Do not change public tool names.

acceptanceEvidenceItems.summary: wiki_decide, wiki_plan, and wiki_implement now call runner-backed iteration functions that use runLoopGraph under the quality-standard adapters.

implementationAssessment.maintainability: The async runner path is isolated behind evaluate<Loop>ExitWithRunner and run<Loop>IterationWithRunner while synchronous evaluators remain for tests and local callers.
implementationAssessment.simplicity: The first production wiring slice keeps existing semantics and avoids introducing judge workers prematurely.
implementationAssessment.projectStyle: Matches the graph/evaluator/quality-standards split and records compact runner metadata in trace output.
implementationAssessment.errorHandling: Runner node exceptions become blocking diagnostics; appendSemanticLoopReport now awaits async loop reports.
implementationAssessment.uncertaintyResolution: Typecheck, targeted tests, full tests, build, lab reports, audit, and diff hygiene passed.
implementationAssessment.rationale: This moves production loop attempts onto the CodeWiki-owned runner while keeping deterministic standards authoritative.
